product_metadata.title: BOLWEO Handheld Cordless Vacuum Cleaner, DC 12V Portable Car Vacuum Cleaner, Strong Suction High Power Hand Vacuum, Lightweight Dry Wet Amphibious Vehicle Cleaner
features: 🌪️Strong Cyclonic Suction: This handheld vacuum has DC 12V 120W strong power to easily suck up your cellphone and books. Children's food slag, sand and stone after outdoor, dust and hair, paper waste can also be cleaned! You can solve all the water and drinks with this wet dry vacuum cleaner! [suction is awesome when using attachments].
🤏Compact and Cordless Design: This cordless hand vacuum is available anywhere, and the portable vacuum is small and compact enough to move it around your wish.

🌊Washable & Reusable filter: This filter can be taken out and easy to be cleaned, you can wash it after every use for a more thorough clean, keep it new and last a longer life, and we'll give you a replacement filter, don't worry about losing it.

🧰Professional Attachments: This cordless hand vacuum comes with 4 serviceable attachments for added versatility: Crevice tool for reaching debris in tight corners & spaces with ease; Dusting brush for easily picking up hair or dirt on delicate surfaces & upholstery; Liquid nozzle for cleaning unexpected liquid spills effortlessly. A high elastic EVA hose can be bent, allowing you to clean the car in any corner.

📦Package & Warm Note:1 x Handheld Cordless Vacuum Cleaner,1 x charger, 1 x USB cable, 1x Vacuum hose,1x Crevice nozzle,1x Brush nozzle,2x Hose adapters,1x Instructions,1x Replacement filter. Our wall charger has IC protection, in order to protect the vacuum, please make sure you first connect the wall outlet then connect the vacuum before charging. (for replacement wall charger, you can search: B08FXCWTB4 ).
